and third tabs here: https://csgorg.sharepoint.com/:x:/s/Team-JC-Research-JJ_AV/EZ-RDTetlZVCoiQxlasiboEBhsT7WNlx5v0qR7sDBji1-A?e=eggzRJ See `Codebooks` and `Data Diagram` tabs for more information on each individual data file. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ### pull in virginia djj data from raw data folder ### set sharepoint path using csgjcr function sharepoint_ojjdp_va_raw_data <- csgjcr::csg_sp_path(file.path("JJ_OJJDP/Data/VA/raw")) ### set sharepoint path using csgjcr function sharepoint_ojjdp_va_viz <- csgjcr::csg_sp_path(file.path("JJ_OJJDP/Output/VA/r_viz_output")) ######################################################## ### import first excel file w/ multiple tabs with purrr ######################################################## ### using purrr::map, import list of tabs from excel worksheet ojjdp_va_raw_tab_list_file_one <- purrr::map(purrr::set_names(excel_sheets(file.path(sharepoint_ojjdp_va_raw_data, "CSG Front End data 01202023 - pt1 - SENSITIVE.xlsx"))), read_excel, path = file.path(sharepoint_ojjdp_va_raw_data,"CSG Front End data 01202023 - pt1 - SENSITIVE.xlsx")) %>% purrr::map(janitor::clean_names) ### clean names of all imported tabs before converting to dataframes names(ojjdp_va_raw_tab_list_file_one) <- janitor::make_clean_names(names(ojjdp_va_raw_tab_list_file_one)) ### then convert list of tabs to distinct dataframes with names from tabs purrr::map(names(ojjdp_va_raw_tab_list_file_one), ~assign(.x, ojjdp_va_raw_tab_list_file_one[[.x]], envir = .GlobalEnv)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` gender ### use factor function to assign labels to values mutate(race_clean = case_when( race=="I" & hispanic!="Y" ~ 1, race=="A" & hispanic!="Y" ~ 2, race=="B" & hispanic!="Y" ~ 3, hispanic=="Y" ~ 4, c("Female", "Male"))) %>% ### clean dates and create year for potential grouping in future trend analysis mutate(date_opened = ymd(as_date(excel_numeric_to_date(as.numeric(as.character(date_opened)), date_system = "modern"))), ysai_date = ymd(as_date(ysai_date)), date_opened_year = year(date_opened)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` distinct: no rows removed ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output
